families.title: Bolt, tension, hex head, close tolerance, alloy steel, short thread, reduced major thread dia., self-locking and nonlocking, 160 ksi Ftu (catalogue title, S21)

material.note: a distributor page calls NAS6203-9 A286 — conflicts with the series title and with the NAS6303-6320 (A286) index; treat as distributor error

families.partNumberPattern: NAS62{dd}[-]{grip}  where dd = diameter dash (03..20), grip = dash in 1/16 in
families.lengthRule: length = grip + threadLength(diameter)  (all grips of one diameter share one thread length)
families.fixtureGripDashRangeNote: TEST FIXTURE ONLY — the real available grip range per diameter is TBD from the NAS sheet / distributor tables

headGeometry.status: tbd — hex head height / across flats not verified; render with parametric placeholder ratios flagged 'representative'

families.title: Rivet, solid, universal head
families.partNumberPattern: MS20470{mat}{d}-{L}  where d = shank diameter in 1/32 in, L = length in 1/16 in (S24)

materialCodes.AD: aluminium alloy (2117-T4 per general knowledge — verify)
materialCodes.DD: aluminium alloy 2024 (verify for rivets; S18 confirms DD = 2024 for AN bolts)

selectionRule.length: L = grip + 1.5 D, rounded to 1/16 in (S19 secondary; Cherry guidance)
selectionRule.shopHead: >= 1.5 D diameter, >= 0.5 D height (attributed to AC 43.13-1B by S19; not confirmed in primary)

variants.HL10: protruding shear head, Ti-6Al-4V, Fsu 95 ksi
variants.HL18: protruding shear head, alloy steel, Fsu 95 ksi

families.partNumberPattern: HLnn-{d}-{g}  d = nominal diameter in 1/32 in, g = MAXIMUM grip in 1/16 in; pin covers ((g-1)/16, g/16]
AN{d}[DD][H]{L}[A]  d = diameter in 1/16 in; DD = 2024 aluminium; A = undrilled shank (S18)
families.lengthCodeStatus: sources disagree whether the dash encodes total length (1/8 in) or grip; resolve from NASM/AN sheet before implementing (OQ-MAT-05)

MS21042.title: Nut, self-locking, reduced hexagon, extended washer, 450 F (all-metal prevailing torque)

NAS1149.partNumberPattern: NAS1149{mat}{size}{thickness code}{finish}; e.g. NAS1149F0332P = #10, 1/32 in, carbon steel, cadmium plated (S27)

gripEqualsMaterialThickness.text: bolt grip length = thickness of material held

maxCombinedWasherHeight_in.text: slightly longer grip allowed with washers under nut or head; max combined washer height 1/8 in

minThreadProtrusion.text: at least one thread of the bolt protruding through the nut (self-locking or plain nuts)

plateNutShim.text: if proper grip not available with plate nuts, add shims under the plate
